newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Solidbank sets record date for rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Solidbank sets record date for rights offer.

text.p: Solidbank Corporation said on Tuesday it had set May 5 as the record date for its one-for-seven stock rights offer.
The bank is offering 1.753 million class A shares, and 1.167 class B shares, which are open to foreigners, to its stockholders.
The offer price has been set at 175 pesos per share and was expected to generate 511 million pesos for the bank.
On Tuesday, the stock was unchanged from the previous day's close of 380 pesos.
The offer period will begin May 6 and end on May 26.
The proceeds of the offer will be used to support growth in the bank's loans portfolio, branch expansion and renovation and automation projects.

The bank has said it expects its assets to grow by 20 percent this year to 46.4 billion pesos from 38.654 billion by the end of last year, while liabilities are seen rising to 41.1 billion pesos from 34.490 billion pesos last year.
